title: free rebirths
script:
local op = 1000 --[[ Change this number to however you like (don't put above 100000)]]--






--[[DO NOT REMOVE THIS PART]]--
local pl = game.Players.LocalPlayer
if pl:FindFirstChild("Backpack") then
pl.Backpack:Destroy()
pl.PlayerGui.Gui:Destroy()
end
wait(0.3)




for I = 1,op do

local args = {
	game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Rebirths"),
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").CurrentTrack,
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").CurrentTrack
}
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Rebirth"):FireServer(unpack(args))
end
wait(op/800)

local ts = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local p = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
ts:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, game.JobId, p)
